text:
harper: Idea \u2014 tiny rooftop fondue + short-film evening this Friday at 7pm? Cheese + chocolate stations, a projector for ~3 short films (10-12 min each). Low-volume, BYO blanket, weather permitting. Who's curious? :movie_camera: :cheese: :cloud:

theo: Love this. I'm game. Can we have a non-dairy dipping option?

maya: In! I'll volunteer to curate the short films (mix of animated + indie). Also bringing a small HDMI hub.

priti: count me in. Happy to handle napkins/serving sticks. Also vegetarian-friendly snacks?

facilities-bot: Note: rooftop bookings require Facilities sign-off for groups >10 and a safety steward. Please submit rooftop_request form at https://redwood.internal/facilities. Weather backup plan: conference room B.

ops-bot: Budget note: team socials under $15/person can be expensed via "team-social" category. For venue prep (steward) there may be an additional fee; submit expense request and tag #lunch-plans.

harper: thanks, facilities-bot. I'll submit the rooftop_request if we hit >8 RSVPs. Doing a quick reaction poll: :cheese: = coming, :chocolate_bar: = coming but only for dessert, :umbrella: = would come only if we use conf room B, :x: = can't make it.

leo-remote: :umbrella: I'll be remote but would love to watch the short films via Zoom if you stream. Happy to pick a film or two.

theo: :cheese:

maya: :cheese:

priti: :chocolate_bar: (I'll arrive late but will bring extra skewers)

harper: Looks like we have enough to try rooftop but will submit the form and reserve conf room B as backup. Maya, could you DM me the film list? Also tagging @events to ask about a tiny steward fee.

facilities-bot: Acknowledged. If the steward fee is under $40 Facilities can approve. Submit rooftop_request with headcount by EOD Thursday.

ops-bot: Reminder: include dietary notes on receipts. If anyone needs allergen-free dips, please add a reply here.

maya: sending film shortlist now. remote folks, if you vote for a film in thread I'll prioritize it.

harper: Thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite with backup location and Zoom link after Facilities confirms. Low-key, 90 minutes tops. See you Friday! :sparkles:
